```{r setup, include=FALSE}
setwd("C:/Users/cl9312/OneDrive - Princeton University/Desktop/Princeton University/Research/P1_MF374 RB-TnSeq project/Results/GK-RGI-Root Colonization-square plates-B1-B5/data_analysis")

#Install packages "data.table", "ggplot2", and "ggpubr"   
install.packages("data.table")
library(data.table)
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
install.packages("ggpubr")
ibrary(ggpubr)

#Read Figure_2B_dat.csv
dat<-fread("Figure_2B_dat.csv")

#Define the Immune_elicitor column as a factor 
dat$Immune_elicitor <- factor(dat$Immune_elicitor, levels = c("Mock", "flg22_Pa"))

#Install more packages "ggsignif","dplyr",and "magrittr"  
install.packages("ggsignif")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("magrittr")
library(dplyr)  
library(magrittr) 
library(ggsignif)

#Define the Strain and SampleID columns as a factor
dat$Strain<-factor(dat$Strain,levels=c("NB","WT","P1","P12","P12+P1","P15"))
dat$SampleID<-as.factor(dat$SampleID)

#Define the Immune_elicitor as a factor and Root_length as numeric
dat$Immune_elicitor <- factor(dat$Immune_elicitor, levels = c("Mock", "flg22_Pa")) 
dat$Root_length <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$Root_length))

# Overall normality check
shapiro.test(dat$Root_length)
qqnorm(dat$Root_length)
qqline(dat$Root_length, col = "red")

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "Mock"
mock_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "Mock")

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from Mock group
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

mock_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

# Subset only rows where Immune_elicitor == "flg22_Pa"
flg22_Pa_data <- subset(dat, Immune_elicitor == "flg22_Pa")

# Run Shapiro–Wilk test on Concentration values from flg22_Pa group
flg22_Pa_data %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_length)

#Dunn's test
library(FSA)
Dun_result_dat<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ SampleID, data = dat, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat$res, "Dun_result_dat_flg22_Pa.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_mock<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = mock_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_mock$res, "Dun_result_dat_mock_flg22_Pa.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Dun_result_dat_flg22_flg22_Ps<-dunnTest(Root_length ~ Strain, data = flg22_Pa_data, method = "bh")  # or "bonferroni"
write.csv(Dun_result_dat_flg22_flg22_Pa$res, "Dun_result_dat_flg22_flg22_Pa_flg22_Pa.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Define a 6-color palette 
strain_col13 <- c(
  "NB" = "#0c74b9",
  "WT" = "#d55427",
  "P1" = "#e5ae23",
  "P12" = "#802f89",
  "P12+P1" = "#74a641",
  "P15" = "#5abbea"
)

strain_labels <- c(
  "P1"      = expression(Delta * italic("ppiD")),
  "P12"     = expression(Delta * italic("tonB1::Gm"^"R")),
  "P12+P1"  = expression(Delta * italic("tonB1::Gm"^"R")*Delta * italic("ppiD")),
  "P15"  = expression(Delta * italic("trpEXGDC")))
#trps:"trpE-BLR19_RS02895-trpG-trpD-trpC"

#Run ggplot for making a boxplot
p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Strain, y = Root_length,fill = Strain)) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, color = "black", size = 0.6,alpha = 0.5,outlier.size = 2) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Strain), size = 3, alpha = 0.6,
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Immune_elicitor, scales = "free_x", labeller = labeller(Immune_elicitor = c("Mock" = "Mock", "flg22_Pa" = "flg22-Pa"))) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col13,labels = strain_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = strain_col13,labels = strain_labels) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Root elongation (cm)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(size = 2),
    axis.line = element_line(size = 1.2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", color = "black"),  # facet title size
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10))

#Show the boxplot
p

#Save the boxplot as a tiff file
ggsave("Figure_2B.tif", plot = p, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "tiff",compression = "lzw")

#Save the boxplot as a svg file
ggsave("Figure_2B.svg", plot = p, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "svg")
```
